methodology.intro: The footprint is computed per presence day (office or remote). Active referential: {{year}} · radiative forcing ×{{rf}}.
methodology.introGeneric: The footprint is computed per presence day (office or remote), from a year-versioned referential of emission factors.
methodology.error: Could not load the emission-factor referential.
methodology.noProfile: Select a profile to display the emission-factor referential.

formula.title: How the impact is computed
formula.tripNote: Distance is one-way; a round trip doubles it. The division by occupants only applies to per-vehicle factors (carpooling). An unknown mode falls back to the average car (estimated result).
formula.day: total = Σ trips + building energy (if enabled)
formula.dayNote: Vacation and holiday days are always 0. Building energy (office/remote) is added only when the option is enabled.

params.title: Calculation parameters
params.radiativeForcingDesc: Aviation factors include radiative forcing (×{{rf}} for the {{year}} referential). Disabling it divides by this multiplier to keep direct CO₂ only.
params.carpoolDesc: A car trip's footprint is divided by the number of occupants.
params.buildingDesc: Optional daily amount (heating, electricity) added to office/remote days, excluding the commute.
params.gridCountryDesc: For electric cars, the footprint depends on the charging country's electricity mix.
params.yearDesc: The referential is versioned by year; already-encoded days keep their frozen footprint.

sources.title: Sources
sources.intro: Factors come from public referentials. Click to open the source in your browser.

transparency.title: Transparency & limitations
transparency.item1: Combustion-car factors use an earlier ADEME vintage (the current 2025 tool is lower); the order of magnitude remains correct.
transparency.item2: The plug-in hybrid assumes mostly-electric usage (optimistic estimate).
transparency.item3: The SNCB train reflects a historical traction figure; the current value (green electricity) is lower.
transparency.item4: "Public transport (mix)" is an internal weighted average, not a published ADEME factor.
transparency.item5: Aviation factors include radiative forcing; medium-haul is an interpolation (no dedicated DEFRA band).
